engine: CFB OUTCOME ENGINE v1 (RESEARCH / SHADOW ONLY): the college version of the NFL Phase 1 architecture - one shared pregame state engine feeding independently validated outcome heads

research_cutoff.rule: 2026 Week 4 completed games ONLY may exist anywhere in this rebuild; 2026 Week >= 5 is rejected by the research loader (cfb_phase1_common.assert_research_allowed)
research_cutoff.week5: Week 5 remains evidence for the OLD CFB system (FORBIDDEN_FROM_MODEL_RESEARCH)

periods.development_model_selection: rolling folds ending no later than 2024 (exact years registered after the source audit, before any performance)
periods.2026_week_6_plus: CLEAN_FORWARD_CANDIDATE (earliest possible new-engine forward start = 2026 Week 6; Week 7 if the freeze cannot be completed legitimately)

predictive_input_rule: no sportsbook line, odds, spread, total, implied probability or market-derived field anywhere in a predictive feature; if sportsbooks disappear the engine must still work

rushing_yards.walk_forward: NOT fully stable: verdict CFB_RUSHING_YARDS_WALKFORWARD_NOT_YET_STABLE (away-slice gate failed), shipped with SHIP_WITH_DISCLOSED_AWAY_SLICE_CAVEAT

anytime_touchdowns.note: OVER-only (no real under market); comparator only

moneyline.note: game-level win probability classifier; comparator only

passing_yards.reason: failed re-validation after the completion / attribution correction (cfb_serving_builder_a.SUSPENDED_MARKETS); not rescued

receiving_yards.reason: failed re-validation after the reception / attribution correction (cfb_serving_builder_a.SUSPENDED_MARKETS); not rescued

rushing_touchdowns.evidence: champion gate passed + walk-forward stable (cfb_rushing_touchdowns_*_report.json) but it is NOT an active board market

prior_season_bootstrap_models.scope: *_early_season markets (rushing_yards, passing_touchdowns, anytime_touchdowns, moneyline) built from prior-season information for early weeks; separate population keys on the board
prior_season_bootstrap_models.note: inventory only; early-season markets are not grandfathered into the new engine; their present board activity is a production concern, unchanged here

fcs_specific_models.scope: cfb_fcs_* clean baselines / champion gates (rushing, passing, receiving, passing TD) on the separate FCS database cfb_fcs_model.sqlite (2022-2025)
fcs_specific_models.note: result reports are not retained in the repo; no FCS model is served

context_v2.scope: production models of rushing_yards, passing_touchdowns, anytime_touchdowns, moneyline (Platt calibrated on completed 2025)

champion_growing_pool_models.scope: *_champion_gate_a / walk-forward champions with weekly growing-pool Platt calibration (the calibration layer applied on top of context_v2 on the live board)

simulation_gates.scope: cfb_rush_sim*, cfb_pass_td_sim_gate_a, cfb_pass_yards_sim_gate_a, cfb_recv_sim_gate_a (sim_projected = 0 on the live board)

do_not_grandfather: no legacy model, feature set, threshold or calibration is inherited by the new engine; legacy models are comparators evaluated on the SAME candidate universe where possible

player_identity_stitching.evidence: cfb_identity_contract.json + cfb_identity_audit.json (2,918 producer transfers keep the same positive ESPN athlete_id, 0 name conflicts; placeholder / unresolved ids never stitched)

candidate_universe_point_in_time.evidence: cfb_candidate_universe_contract.json; skill producers inside the candidate set 88.8-92.0% per season; target-week mutation test passes

team_environment (plays, pace, pass/rush.evidence: cfb_shared_state_contract.json; internal rating + B0 blends; T1 C1 beats its baseline (historical development only)

role_state (QB attempt share, carry shar.note: role features built; carry-share C1 failed its slice gate; receptions replace targets (no target source); red-zone shares not built

availability_participation.note: box-score participation only (no snaps / injuries / depth: BLOCKED_HISTORICAL_PIT); P1 C1 beats its baseline (development only)

organizational_intent_prior.note: only returning / transfer-newcomer flags exist; recruiting, portal, depth, coaching sources BLOCKED_NO_SOURCE

fbs_fcs_regime.note: O_IS_FCS flag + shrinkage to the league mean (FCS teams have almost no observed games); player universe is FBS-vs-FBS only

team_total_plays.note: derivable as rush + pass attempts + sacks once both volumes exist; not scored separately

team_rush_attempts.label: HISTORICAL DEVELOPMENT ONLY (2021-2024 validation); 2025 late confirmation not scored

carry_share_O1.challenger_C1: FROZEN_REJECTED: G4 slice guard failed (TE +20.4%, WR +8.8% worse CRPS than B0; QB -17% / RB -20% better, overall -18.2% better); no rescue tuning
carry_share_O1.known_weakness: B0 over-predicts mean carries by ~29% (allocation-only evaluation, realized team total); a position-specific carrier model would need a NEW protocol

receiver_targets.note: frozen CFB player_games has NO targets column: feasibility pending (likely BLOCKED for history)

outcome_heads.status_note: No outcome head is certified: only upstream components were tested

head_rule: CFB is one state engine with multiple independently certified outcome heads: no head is 'finished' because another works; a failed head is frozen / rejected and independent components continue

stages_complete: 11 baselines vs challengers for T1 / T2 / P1 / O1
12 development metrics (CRPS / NLL / PIT / coverage / slices / block bootstrap)
not_started: 6 outcome families beyond volume / participation / carry share
